note_records.text: **2026-09-29** — (recorded 2026-09-28 on S01) Security contract agreed: accidental-exposure risk reduction for controlled workflows; sharing is case-by-case. Docs cover retained structure and inference risk, manifest confidentiality, deterministic leakage, current compatibility, and no new crypto dependency.

note_records.text: **2026-10-07** — Ready for review: branch ob-02-cli-credentials, commit 7b4e307. Inline --passphrase and --passphrase=<x> rejected (case-insensitive) with no value echo; env/file/stdin kept; library API unchanged. Tests: dotnet test 65/65 pass (new Cli_PassphraseFromFile_RoundTrips, Cli_InlinePassphrase_IsRejectedWithoutEcho x3, Cli_PassphraseFileFollowedByAnotherFlag_Fails); scripts/test-local.sh passes and writes OBF_AESGCM_V3 manifests via OBFUSCATOR_PASSPHRASE. Follow-ups filed: ob-07, ob-08.

goals: Make CSV obfuscation and restoration safer to use for library and CLI users, while maintaining synthetic CSV generation as an equally important product capability. Harden the current 0.1 line over the next 1–2 releases, prioritizing safe data handling and risk reduction.
non_goals: Do not claim obfuscation alone provides cryptographic secrecy. Do not require encrypted manifests by default. Do not target a 1.0 release in this roadmap.
